amplitude_binding.selection: Choose justified nonzero signed values within declared family and quantitative omitted-feedback validity range; no fabricated cosmology/shear default and no forced resolvable detection
amplitude_binding.case_mapping: q_ref=sign*amplitude_factor*q_amp; q_ref is signed s_*/H_FLRW(a_*), Sigma=s/H is instantaneous
amplitude_binding.zero_reuse: AX08 imports the AX07 zero case by source/config identity; no duplicate zero-history run

minimum_refinement.bind_before: relevant convergence runs, after supported pilot measurements
minimum_refinement.interpretation: component-wise empirical resolution evidence; rigorous continuum/interval proof separate

minimum_robustness.semantics: scientifically justified source/IC variation; not posterior samples

milestones.meaning: crossing zbar/proper time and signed shift versus matched zero; never QV
milestones.noncrossing: null crossing value plus NOT_REACHED/censored flag and represented interval

numerical_targets.tolerance_binding: before relevant solver comparison; existing immutable checks unchanged
numerical_targets.near_zero: Tiny/null signed abundance effects use absolute response floor and resolution limits, not impossible relative-percent-at-zero accuracy.

run_binding.provider_validation: Selected provider point and any root/interval path actually used have the same physical model/domain. No old FT03 certificate inheritance. A canonical independently validated point-implicit history plus empirical convergence is legitimate at its declared numerical scope; no new rigorous interval proof is mandatory.

scheduling.NCP: Only independent actually-bound cases and measured pilot wall/CPU/RSS, current checkpoint and finite allocation
scheduling.failed_candidates: separate immutable attempt output; no silent overwrite
scheduling.parallelism: Parallelize actual independent cases; each case time evolution remains sequential adaptive integration.

optional_observables.observational_fit: optional and needs appropriate tail/source/inference contract
optional_observables.observed_z_directionality: actual rays and endpoint surfaces required

scientific_completion: Full supported abundance histories plus correctly normalized time/Tgas figures, source/IC robustness, conservation/numerical validation and independent accepted conditional/scientific scope. No detection/novelty forced; optional tau/tail/full CMB not prerequisites.
flagship: Complete actual reionization abundance histories and BBN-style species plots versus proper cosmic time and Tgas

required_species.state: charge-census ne; excluded from baryon inventory; nuclear Z not applicable

abundance_normalization_contract.additional_actually_evolved_species: Every additional evolved nuclide/charge state must be listed with A,Z,charge,element, provenance, state semantics and normalization; never omit it from outputs silently.

element_fraction.electron: not an element charge fraction; null element_fraction, report ye or xe separately

abundance_normalization_contract.baryon_inventory: n_b is the complete baryon inventory of the selected model, including any explicitly declared omitted reservoir; H/He-only baseline n_b=n_H+4*n_He. Electrons are excluded. The tracked sum is the full denominator only when the tracked nuclear registry is complete.
abundance_normalization_contract.BBN_number_abundance: Y_i=n_i/n_b; per baryon in the complete selected-model inventory, distinct from element charge fraction. Do not renormalize to a partial tracked registry.

electron_normalizations.must_label: always name denominator; electrons excluded from nb sum

abundance_normalization_contract.optional_mass_fraction: X_i=A_i*Y_i, separately labelled baryon mass fraction; never mix with number/charge fractions
abundance_normalization_contract.fixed_nuclear_vs_ionic: Donor BBN total elemental/nuclear abundances are fixed input inventory (proper densities expand); reionization evolves charge-state fractions. Do not claim nuclear reaction/BBN synthesis from ionic evolution.
abundance_normalization_contract.conservation: Require nonnegative densities/charge fractions and per-element charge fractions summing to 1. Sum over all model nuclear species A_i*Y_i=1 within the locked tolerance. If a declared baryon reservoir is omitted from the tracked species, tracked sum A_i*Y_i may be <1 and its missing fraction must be explicitly recorded. Check electron charge census separately; never clip invalid states.

omitted_baryon_reservoir.binding: Explicitly record whether selected-model inventory is exactly H/He baseline, all tracked nuclear species, or includes a quantified omitted reservoir. A tracked sum below 1 is legitimate only with that declared inventory.

temperature_plot_contract.time_axis: proper cosmic seconds with bound origin; if only elapsed time available label elapsed correctly
temperature_plot_contract.gas_temperature: Tgas may reheat/be nonmonotonic; plot parametric time-ordered trajectories with arrows/branch labels. Never sort by T to fabricate a single-valued Y(T).
temperature_plot_contract.optional_background_reference: Tref=T0/a with selected model T0, distinctly labelled reference; not exact direction-dependent CMB temperature in Bianchi I.
temperature_plot_contract.logarithmic_abundance_axis: Use where appropriate; exact zeros masked/annotated in display, never clip state or add a fabricated floor.

donor_four_velocity_map.required_donor_binding: Record whether donor uses unit normal or physical four-velocity, coordinate/time units and the explicit conversion; do not silently interchange them.
